verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that monitoring systems can send alerts with relevant data, that Hummingbird groups those alerts into cases, and that it keeps an audit trail of work done in the app. None of this documents a view of what changed on a monitored customer when a new alert fires, such as a diff, change history, or comparison with the prior review. The audit trail covers analyst work, not changes to customer data, so it is only adjacent to this story.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can inspect what changed when a monitored customer produces a new alert
